headline: Set Geno Smith as Joe Burrow's AutoSub before Sunday's 10:00 AM PT kickoff (both games start together).
summary: Danny is 1-0 and the lineup is already right: Shakir already played, Aaron Jones has the clearer workload over Lloyd and Judkins, and Juwan Johnson (cleared an illness Friday) stays over Kyle Pitts, who managed one target all of Week 1. The only open action is insuring Burrow's Questionable back with an AutoSub before it locks; nothing on the wire beats what's already on the bench.
